notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (curl) has no Claude-specific or blanket disallow, so all tiers permitted; tier (a) direct HTTP fetch returned only a ~78KB JS-app shell for every route (homepage and category pages identical size, no real DOM), so escalated to tier (b) Playwright/CDP (headless chromium, networkidle) to read rendered h1/body text - no anti-bot wall encountered, no need for tier (c). TREE: built from union of media/sitemap_en_ca.xml (3518 URLs filtered to 485 non-product category-shaped URLs) plus each candidate page's own rendered h1/subcategory nav; confirmed h1 text matches the requested node's own name on every leaf recorded (e.g. h1='STORAGE OTTOMAN' for the storage-organization/ottomans slug, h1='CUSHIONS' for home-accents/cushions), ruling out silent parent-total fallback. Site is a Magento-based furniture retailer (Decor / Furniture / Mattresses top nav) with no dedicated Textiles or Curtains/Towels/Linens section at all - only Cushions, Rugs (under Decor>Home Accents) and Bedding (under Furniture>Bedroom) qualify as Textile. QTY: read directly from rendered page body text pattern 'N items' (Magento toolbar amount), e.g. 'CUSHIONS' page showed '151 items' and 'of 151' in pagination text - no estimation/aggregation. EXCLUDED: Decor>Home Accents> decorative-accessories, vases-bowls-trays, artificial-flowers-planters (decorative objects, textile.md SS23 / storage.md SS24 boundary - not textile, not storage); Decor>Lighting and Decor>Wall-Decor (mirrors, wall-art-paintings - lighting/wall-decor boundary, no textile wall-hangings subtype found); all other Furniture>* leaves (living-room seating/tables, dining-room, bedroom beds/chests/nightstands, office desks/chairs, entryway benches/console, outdoor) - furniture boundary, not storage since explicitly placed in Furniture nav sections rather than the Storage & Organization section; Furniture>Office>office-cabinets and Furniture>Dining-Room>sideboards-buffets explicitly excluded from Storage because the website places them under Furniture nav (Office / Dining Room), not under the dedicated 'Storage & Organization' section (storage.md SS21 explicit-placement rule) - plain Furniture>Living-Room>ottomans (regular seating ottomans, distinct node from the storage-organization ottomans) also excluded from Storage for the same reason. Storage & Organization parent page (h1='STORAGE & ORGANIZATION', 79 items) not recorded as its own row (qty/link) because it has 3 valid subcategories (bookcases-shelves, cabinets, ottomans) per storage.md SS34 parent-URL rule - used only as a grouping row.
